about: Machine packages' reconstruction recipes (sdk/runtime/loader/build.py --octabam-machine): authored runs of each package image that coincide with stock, as copies of the identical bytes of the user's own OS, so the package passes the unchanged strict stock-free scans. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 only; captured with --capture-stock-recipe and bound to the exact image and sources. Purposes are machine-captured and await review.
